test_title: PYST 10: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **for.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"for"** is a preposition used to indicate the purpose, reason, or intended recipient of an action. (के लिए)

 
 
• **Example: **This gift is for you.
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this context, it is said that Rex, Kasturi's dog, was there to greet her.
